issue: The uploaded batch contains six Swiggy quarterly letters only; no Eternal shareholder letters are present.
impact: FoodIQ cannot yet compute Eternal-versus-Swiggy competitive gaps, cross-company leading indicators or peer-relative conclusions.
required_action: Keep company=Eternal absent/null; build schema to support it but never generate proxy values. Upload matched Eternal letters for same quarters.

issue: Q1FY27 Platform MTU differs: Q1FY27 letter page 5 reports 27.5m, while Q2FY27 historical chart page 5 displays 26.2m.
impact: Changes growth calculations / historical trend. No explanatory restatement note identified on the KPI page.
required_action: Store separate document-specific observations; flag possible restatement or error; chart latest-reported series with conflict annotation and maintain as-published series.

issue: Historical platform frequency differs across letters: Q1FY26 4.18 in Q1FY26 letter vs 4.13 in Q1FY27 historical chart; Q1FY27 3.87 in Q1FY27 letter vs 3.92 in Q2FY27 historical chart.
impact: Historical trend / cohort comparisons change.
required_action: Preserve each published observation with report date; do not silently overwrite.

issue: Swiggy management explicitly says Food Delivery NOV is not published because discounts are not structurally comparable; use Food GOV.
impact: The project specification originally proposed NOV normalisation for Food. A Food NOV field would be unsupported.
required_action: Make GOV the core Food comparison metric; keep NOV blank. Capture statement and page.

issue: Swiggy management also states it does not publish Out-of-Home NOV for similar structural comparability reasons.
impact: Cannot make OOH NOV-based analysis from this source pack.
required_action: Use OOH GOV; do not infer NOV.

issue: The user seed-data uses segment=Consolidated and GOV values that are B2C GOV, while adjusted revenue/EBITDA are consolidated metrics.
impact: Different scopes are mixed within one row; misleading ratios can result.
required_action: Separate B2C GOV, B2C adjusted revenue, consolidated adjusted revenue, consolidated adjusted EBITDA and Platform Innovations.

issue: Margin denominators differ by segment: Food/QuickCommerce/OOH contribution and adjusted EBITDA margins are generally as % GOV; Supply Chain EBITDA margin is % revenue; Platform Innovations margin is % adjusted revenue; Platform B2C margin is % B2C GOV.
impact: Invalid peer or segment comparisons if margins are treated as one common ratio.
required_action: Store denominator in each metric observation and metric definition; never compare without matched basis.

issue: Seed absolute QuickCommerce NOV series appears partly inferred from NOV/GOV ratios and partly explicitly reported. Q1FY27 and Q2FY27 source ratios are rounded to whole percentages while absolute values do not equal exact multiplication.
impact: A derived approximation can be mistaken for a company-reported absolute metric.
required_action: Keep seed values in a separate user-submitted series, add source_status, and confirm each quarter from text or table before promotion to reported status.

issue: Q2FY27 source discusses nAOV ₹506 while KPI chart reports AOV ₹708; Q1FY27 source discusses nAOV ₹508 while chart AOV is ₹691. No complete definition of nAOV was located in glossary.
impact: Substituting nAOV for AOV would create a false trend / mismatch with orders and GOV.
required_action: Retain separate metrics aov_inr and naov_inr; capture exact definition if found; do not substitute.

issue: QComm monthly contribution break-even was achieved in May 2026, but Q1FY27 quarterly average was -0.2% and Q2FY27 quarterly average was -1.0%.
impact: A simple “break-even achieved” label would misrepresent the run-rate and reinvestment dynamics.
required_action: Store milestone date/value, quarterly averages and subsequent margin investment explanation separately.

issue: Lynks stake sale disclosed in Q2FY27; Lynks segment results cease being included from Q3FY27 and management expects ~₹20cr segment EBITDA benefit.
impact: Supply Chain / Distribution segment trend has structural discontinuity.
required_action: Add corporate-action structural-break event; normalise historical comparison or disclose perimeter difference.

issue: The spec assumes take_rate_pct = adjusted revenue / NOV. Source management take-rate references (Food 25.8% / 26.1%, QuickComm 14.8%) do not have a complete consistent formula established in the supplied definitions.
impact: Derived take rates could be wrong or not comparable.
required_action: Use source-reported take-rate series only where explicit; do not calculate from guessed numerator/denominator. Add definition and source reference.

issue: The original spec proposes a contribution margin bridge using delta take-rate + volume leverage + residual cost. This does not mathematically reconcile without component-level disclosed revenue/cost amounts and correct denominators.
impact: Could create pseudo-precision / double-counting.
required_action: Build a monetary CM = CM% × GOV series; produce attribution only where actual driver components reconcile to the total change. Treat management bps bridge separately as management attribution.

issue: AOV lead correlation with ~8–10 quarterly observations cannot establish causal prediction.
impact: Interview claim may overstate statistical evidence.
required_action: Call it exploratory lead/lag association; compare lag 0/1/2, level and first-difference series, confidence interval, p value, sample size and common-trend caveats.

issue: The user seed labels certain guidance as met/missed based on one observation and treats ongoing medium-term goals alike.
impact: Management scorecard may falsely label long-term ambitions as missed.
required_action: Classify each item as formal annual guidance, near-term guidance, scale threshold, medium-term ambition, long-term aspiration, or qualitative strategy. Use pending / achieved milestone / in-range / approximately met with evidence.

issue: Quarterly orders per store/day are based on active darkstore-days; store count at quarter-end is not the same denominator.
impact: Recalculated productivity from total orders / closing store count will be inaccurate.
required_action: Use published orders/store/day directly or reconstruct from active store-days if available; document denominator.

issue: Q1 food metrics are seasonally affected by monsoon, delivery partner availability, reverse migration and salary cycle; Q2/Q3 have festive season effects.
impact: Simple QoQ movement may be seasonal rather than structural.
required_action: Prefer YoY comparisons and seasonal annotations; where enough data exists, include seasonal controls.

issue: Several metrics like GOV/sqft, estimated order productivity and annualised run-rate are not equivalent to audited revenue or profitability.
impact: Mixing operational ratios with reported financial statements reduces credibility.
required_action: Tag every value as reported / derived / management estimate / user-provided / model assumption.

issue: Seed data currently ends at Q1FY27, while Q2FY27 letter is uploaded and includes an additional quarter.
impact: Dataset is stale relative to supplied source pack.
required_action: Add Q2FY27 rows from Q2FY27 KPI charts and use source-specific page references.

issue: Company page-16 cash reconciliation balance is not necessarily identical to statutory “cash and cash equivalents” balance-sheet line.
impact: Potential inconsistent liquidity comparisons.
required_action: Preserve line-item label and source context; never merge the two cash concepts.
